meta_description_en: Press roundup and news: Your Sinclair review, the demise of Your Computer, a new Sinclair-branded PC from Amstrad, and Anamartic wafer-scale news.
meta_description_ru: Краткие новости и обзор прессы: журнал Your Sinclair, закрытие Your Computer, новый PC под маркой Sinclair от Amstrad и инвестиции в Anamartic.
body_en_plain:
L O O K O U T !
Our schedule is so messed about
by the postal strike and various
events I can only cover YOUR
SINCLAIR this month. This has a
review of CP/M and Mallard BASIC
for the +3. "Program Pitstop" is
devoted to 128K music routines.
I might add that the front cover
sets a new low in bad taste even
for my liberal outlook.They must
be hoping for publicity at any
cost.

YOUR COMPUTER has been abandoned
by its publishers(as I suspected
last month)but the name may be
taken up by another publisher.In
my view YOUR COMPUTER died some
time age. R.I.P.

Amstrad have a new computer with
the Sinclair name - a PC machine
at about `300.

Woolworth's will increase the
number of their stores stocking
software in October so it may be
worth checking out your local.

Anamartic,Sinclair's wafer-scale
company, has had `6 million plus
invested from various sources so
we ought to see new data storage
devices replacing disk drives
for some applications next year.
Roll on the clockwork microdrive
I say....

body_en:
## LOOKOUT!

Our schedule is so messed about by the postal strike and various events I can only cover YOUR SINCLAIR this month. This has a review of CP/M and Mallard BASIC for the +3. "Program Pitstop" is devoted to 128K music routines. I might add that the front cover sets a new low in bad taste even for my liberal outlook. They must be hoping for publicity at any cost.

YOUR COMPUTER has been abandoned by its publishers (as I suspected last month) but the name may be taken up by another publisher. In my view YOUR COMPUTER died some time age. R.I.P.

Amstrad have a new computer with the Sinclair name - a PC machine at about `300.

Woolworth's will increase the number of their stores stocking software in October so it may be worth checking out your local.

Anamartic, Sinclair's wafer-scale company, has had `6 million plus invested from various sources so we ought to see new data storage devices replacing disk drives for some applications next year. Roll on the clockwork microdrive I say....
body_ru:
### Внимание!

Наш график настолько сбит забастовкой почты и прочими событиями, что в этом месяце я могу осветить только YOUR SINCLAIR. Там есть обзор CP/M и Mallard BASIC для +3. Раздел "Program Pitstop" посвящён музыкальным процедурам для 128K. Могу добавить, что обложка ставит новый рекорд безвкусицы даже на мой либеральный взгляд. Должно быть, они надеются на шумиху любой ценой.

Издатели забросили YOUR COMPUTER (как я и ожидал в прошлом месяце), но имя может перенять другой издатель. По-моему, YOUR COMPUTER умер уже давно. R.I.P.

У Amstrad новый компьютер с маркой Sinclair — это PC-машина примерно за `300.

Woolworth's в октябре увеличит число магазинов, продающих софт, так что, возможно, стоит заглянуть в местный филиал.

Anamartic, компания Sinclair по wafer-scale, получила более `6 million инвестиций из разных источников, так что в будущем году мы должны увидеть новые накопители, заменяющие дисководы для некоторых задач. Скорей бы заводной microdrive, скажу я...
